land_pattern.package: 5.08mm pitch, 2x round THT holes, single row
land_pattern.notes: From the vendor's 'PCB LAYOUT' view (the recommended-footprint drawing, distinct from the package-outline views above it): 2x round through-holes on 5.08mm pitch, single row. End margin from body edge to first hole center is 2.54mm (half pitch), consistent with the overall body length dimension N x 5.08mm = 10.16mm for this 2-pole part. The ONLY hole-size figure the drawing states is a 1.50mm dimension attached to a hole via a diagonal leader line in the PCB-layout view, read here as the DRILL diameter (standard convention for that leader style on this vendor's drawings) - the drawing gives no separate copper-pad/annular-ring diameter, so size the pad per house/fab minimum annular ring over this 1.50mm drill. The pins themselves are rectangular in cross-section, approx. 0.90mm x 0.80mm (0.90 called out in the front/pin view, 0.80 in the side view of the solder tail) rather than round, so the round drill must clear the pin's ~1.20mm diagonal - plausible given the 1.50mm drill. Two further dimensions appear on the drawing (3.14mm, vertical, in the PCB-layout view; 4.20mm, vertical, in the front/pin view) whose exact reference datum could not be pinned down with confidence from the rendered page - re-check the vendor drawing directly before finalizing the KiCad footprint (see OPEN).
